image_bank_policy: Whole image-bank set replacement on load; this standalone pack occupies bank 0; banks 1 and 2 are blank. Merge with other sprites at build time.
notes: Color indices, transparent margin and artwork are unchanged from art v0.1.0.
anchor_px uses image-boundary coordinates; (16,32) is intentional.
No .pyxpal is supplied. Do not load a same-stem custom palette.
Do not change collider, cube_size, shadow, hover, camera or input in this format change.
If image banks are in use, integrate the canonical HEX through the project build step instead of loading this standalone pack over existing image banks.
